message:
Just chiming in... the Emerging Social Software SIG got accepted (our proposal was to replace the separate panels on blogs and wikis), and assuming I get the funding, I'll be bringing three of my most dedicated undergraduate bloggers along with me for a panel called "When Student Experts Remix the Discipline: New Media in the Composition Classroom."

A workshop on pedagogical uses of video games didn't get accepted (the first workshop I've proposed, and definitely the toughest proposal I've ever written), but two out of three ain't bad.
